title: Animal groups | Grade 1 Science | Little Takhti
description:
Grade 1 Science: Animal groups.
Animals are sorted into groups. Mammals have fur and feed babies milk. Birds have feathers and lay eggs. Fish live in water and breathe with gills. Reptiles have dry scaly skin. Amphibians live in water and on land. Insects have six legs and no backbone.

Free printable worksheets with answer keys and a quiz game for this topic: https://littletakhti.netlify.app/#res-science-t11
